title: When the Room Falls
author: Jude Marchetti
blurb: Tamsin Ashgrove, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
